issue.body:
Is there any interest in including a `TemplateEndpoint` class in Starlette? 

I initially made an attempt [here](https://github.com/encode/starlette/pull/211). The previous PR only supported a sync version, though I have implemented an async version [here](https://github.com/erm/guitarlette/blob/master/guitarlette/endpoints.py).

 I could submit a new PR and include any feedback changes if something like this is desired here.
